objections.objection: T1 (kalkış tamamlandı) cannot complete inside its own 3.4 s window. alpha reaches 0 only at the end of the stand ramp: tr35 STAND_RAMP_S = 2.5·√1.282 = 2.83 s, which is 142 control steps or 2.84 s because posture_step snaps within 1e-6. T1 then also requires the condition to hold for ready_hold_s = 0.6 s (tr35 SUPERVISOR). The earliest completion is therefore 3.44 s, past the 3.4 s window (MAIN standup_window_s). T1 is also stricter than A5's stand-up success: main_events counts z > standup_z, both feet down and gz < stand_gz inside the window, with no alpha = 0, hold or gyro term. So K7's statement that the S1 threshold (85 %, W-lower 80 %) is derived from A5 does not hold.
objections.scenario: S1 starts seated; nominal model, noise off, a perfect stand-up. The body is upright at about 2.5 s, alpha = 0 at 2.84 s, and the hold ends at 3.44 s. Strict reading ('held condition reached within 3.4 s'): every kalk times out, and S1 completion is 0/256 for any policy. Lenient reading: at 3.40 s the timeout re-issues kalk, which the table itself lists as '—' in K, and the hold ends 40 ms later on the retry. Every stand-up in S1/S2, in the golden traces and in the firmware copy then logs a spurious timeout and uses up its single retry. The two readings give different golden traces, so the firmware cannot match both.
objections.suggestion: Define T1 so it is feasible and deterministic. For example: the condition must first become true within 3.4 s of application, and the hold must end within STAND_RAMP_S + ready_hold_s + 0.6 s ≈ 4.0 s; only that second deadline triggers the timeout or retry. Add a golden-trace and unit test: a nominal kalk on the zero-noise model completes on the first attempt with no timeout. Either score S1's kalk with A5's own success rule, or re-derive the S1 threshold for the stricter T1.
objections.section: K5 Tamamlanma (T1, Zaman aşımı) + K7 S1 Tamamlanma

objections.objection: The zero-velocity gyro-bias update is gated on '|gyro| < 0.02 rad/s for ≥ 1 s'. That threshold is at or below the sensor model's own noise floor, so in simulation the update never fires. This is worst in exactly the ±0.04 rad/s sensitivity run that R13 added to test the update. In sensors.py, gyro_obs is the last 200 Hz sample with per-axis uniform noise of σ = 0.02 rad/s (amplitude ±0.035), plus the episode bias.
objections.scenario: The robot is perfectly still in AYAKTA. Per-sample gate on the 3-axis norm: P(|w| < 0.02) ≈ 0.10 per sample, and 0.10^50 over 1 s at 50 Hz, so the gate never opens. A z-only per-sample gate gives 0.58^50 ≈ 1e-12. With a gate on the 1 s mean instead, the mean is about the bias. In the U(±0.04) sensitivity run the gate stays shut whenever |b_z| > 0.02 (half the episodes, those with the largest bias), or in about 94 % of episodes for a 3-axis norm. Those turns integrate the full bias: 0.02–0.04 rad/s × 4.45 s = 5–10° per 90° turn, accumulating over the sequence. The report then says nothing about the estimator. On hardware the MPU6500 noise is about 10× lower, so the firmware's gate does open. Sim and robot take different branches, and no noisy golden trace ever exercises the update.
objections.suggestion: Gate on dispersion, not magnitude. Over a 1 s window: per-axis std(gyro_obs) < k·σ_gyro (for example 2σ = 0.04 rad/s in sim, from the measured σ on the robot), the change in gravity_obs < 0.5°, and the state is A with a zero command for ≥ 1 s, or M. The bias estimate is the window mean, clamped to |b| ≤ 0.1. Unit test with sensors.imu_tick, noise on and bias U(±0.04): estimate error < 0.005 rad/s after 2 s still. In the A10 sensitivity run, report the fraction of turns that started with an updated bias.
objections.section: K5 Gyro bias + K7 Duyarlılık

objections.objection: In KALKIYOR the new fall rule ('tilt > 35° from pitch_ref(alpha)') fires on the main stand-up failure mode, which R4 described as rocking back onto the seat. That happens before the timeout-and-retry path R4 asked for, so getup is launched from a seated pose. Getup's reset distribution (fallen 0.70 / midfall 0.10 / stand 0.20, TASK.md) never contains that pose.
objections.scenario: On the stub derivation: seat pitch −50° (nose up); crouch rows give pitch_F(H_DEEP = 0.086) ≈ −19.8° and pitch_F(0.097) ≈ −9.9°. With the S1 seated start, kalk is applied and the robot partly lifts, but the COM does not get over the feet (stub seat COM margin 6.9 mm). It rocks back onto the trunk box at about t = 1.3 s. alpha ≈ 0.5 then gives pitch_ref ≈ −10° while the body sits at −50°: 40° > 35° for 6 steps, so DÜŞMÜŞ. getup takes over a robot that is just sitting. Its behaviour from that start is untested (A6 is stratified over front/side/back fallen banks only). The R4 'timeout → re-issue kalk once' path is never reached for this case. On the robot the user sees a getup flail instead of a retry.
objections.suggestion: In O/K, declare a fall only if the tilt is > 35° from both pitch_ref(alpha) and the seat pose. A posture consistent with sitting (tilt within 15° of SEAT_PITCH_DEG and gz_obs < seat_gz) counts as 'kalkış başarısız': send sit = 1, wait for T2, then use the single retry. Alternatively, or in addition, add a seated reset kind (about 10 %, from PB.seated_bank) to getup training and to A6's per-mode table. Add a scripted rock-back golden trace.
objections.section: K5 Düşme ve devir + durum tablosu (K satırı, 'düşme algılandı')

objections.objection: The gesture channel has no smooth stop, and its gate is self-contradictory. K4/K5 say 'dur … jest kesilir' (immediately), and K6.1 gives gestures 'the same alpha gate as the random offset'. Because the gesture bypasses the filter, both produce a one-step position jump. The random offset avoids this only because its gate acts on the filter input. R1 flagged the cut-off case explicitly. In addition, the same alpha gate (alpha < 0.01) zeroes the beak in sit segments, where K6.1 says it is sampled. Finally, the env (xp) and commands.py (numpy) would each implement the waveform, so there are two definitions.
objections.scenario: 'hayır' is running (head_yaw ±0.4 rad, 1.2 Hz) and the user says 'dur' about 0.8 s in. The envelope is at about 0.854, so the commanded offset is up to 0.34 rad. The gesture is zeroed in one 20 ms step. The MG90S slews at ω0 = 13.1 rad/s (up to 18 with DR ×1.4), about 2–3× the spec's 0.5·ω0 = 6.55 rad/s limit, which K6.1 itself asserts. head_yaw qd·0.05 jumps to about 0.65 in the observation, against ≤ about 0.24 in training. The same step happens in training whenever a sit segment starts mid-gesture and the gate closes at the second ramp step (alpha 0.014). Separately, seated vak (allowed in M, ≤ 15°) is never trained if the mouth shares the gate.
objections.suggestion: Define one xp-generic gesture function in task_math, called by env_cpu, env_mjx and commands.py. The gate acts only at gesture start: head gestures need alpha < 0.01; the mouth needs alpha < 0.01 or alpha = 1 (amplitude ≤ 15° when alpha = 1). Any cut (dur, otur, segment change) is a raised-cosine fade-out over 0.25 s: the peak rate then stays ≤ 0.34·(2π·1.2 + π/0.5) ≈ 4.7 rad/s < 6.55. Assert the slew on the output, not only on the template. Add a golden trace for 'hayır' cut by 'dur'.
objections.section: K6.1 Jest kanalı + K4/K5 (dur: jest kesilir)

objections.objection: 'Her oturuştan önce ≥ 1 s ayakta segment' makes every trained sit start from h = H_HOME. The stand segment sets h = H_HOME (TASK.md, sample_segment), and a sit keeps the previous h. The pre-v2 sampler covered sits after crouch and walk segments with h in [H_MIN_STAND, H_HOME]; v2 removes them. The controller's 'eğil … otur' path sits with h_cmd = H_HOME − ΔH or H_MIN_WALK, so the whole O → M → K cycle is out of distribution. Also, 'otur' in A is applied immediately even if 'dur' was 0.5 s earlier, so the 1 s rule is not guaranteed by the controller. Finally, 'Her segmentin süresi U(3.5, 15) s' does not say whether it applies only to the atom segments.
objections.scenario: In S2, eğil and yüksel are each 1/12 of words and every stand-up resets h to H_HOME. At the next otur, h_cmd < H_HOME whenever the last height word since the stand-up was eğil, which is roughly a third of S2 sits. The policy then sits with posture[0] = command h_n = (0.1323 − 0.1522)/0.0596 = −0.33, or −0.67 at H_MIN_WALK, for the whole 2.84 s ramp and seated phase. During the next stand-up h_ref also ramps up 1–2 s (at H_RATE). With the v2 sampler the policy never saw these values while alpha > 0. If 'her segmentin' is read as all segments, the mean segment length goes from 5 s to 9.25 s, roughly halving the transitions per 20 s episode that A5 depends on.
objections.suggestion: Make the pre-sit segment a zero-velocity hold of at least 1 s that keeps the previous h; for example a 'hold' kind, or the stand kind with h = prev h. Keep crouch → sit, so the h at sit onset covers [H_MIN_STAND, H_HOME]. In the controller, let 'otur' in A wait out the rest of 1.0 s since the last non-zero velocity. Write 'her atom segmentinin süresi U(3.5, 15) s'. State which of the 8 sample_segment uniforms the atom choice reuses: all 8 are used today ([tur, süre, sıfır, vx, vy, wz, h-modu, h]), so either name the slot or raise NUM_SEGMENT_U. Add a sampler test: a histogram of h_cmd at sit onset spans [H_MIN_WALK, H_HOME].
objections.section: K6.2 Komut atomları + K5 tablo (otur, A)

objections.objection: The S1 gesture and height criteria are not well defined. A raised-cosine envelope over the whole 2-cycle gesture means the commanded peaks are only 0.146, 0.854, 0.854 and 0.146 of the table amplitude. 'Genlik ≥ komutun %80'i' does not say whether 'komut' means the table amplitude or the enveloped command. It names no cycle or peak-to-peak, and neither it nor 'eğil/yüksel: her adımda … ≥ 0.5·ΔH' gives a quantile or a measurement time.
objections.scenario: 'evet': the commanded peak-to-peak is 2·0.854·0.2 rad = 19.6°, which is 85.4 % of the table's 2·11.5°. With MG90S DR (deadband up to 0.9° full width, P-band up to 8°, head_pitch static load 0.054 of stall) the pot peak-to-peak loses about 1°, roughly 5 %. Against the table amplitude the result is ≈ 81 %, so the 80 % check passes or fails depending on the DR draw. Read as 'every episode', one bad episode fails A10. The user also sees one large nod and two small ones, not '2 çevrim'. For eğil, the trunk is still lagging when |h_ref − h_cmd| < 1e-6 (ΔH = 19.9 mm reached in 0.99 s), and a 0.20 m/s push in that window can take Δz below 9.9 mm.
objections.suggestion: Use a Tukey envelope with half-cycle tapers, so the gesture reaches full amplitude for one cycle and the peak rate stays < 0.5·ω0. Criterion: pot peak-to-peak over the central cycle ≥ 0.8 × commanded peak-to-peak over the same cycle, p10 over episodes. eğil/yüksel: measure Δz (or the IMU-free trunk z in sim) 1 s after h_ref reaches its target, p10 ≥ 0.5·ΔH.
objections.section: K6.1 jest tablosu + K7 S1 Ölçütler (evet/hayır, eğil/yüksel)

objections.objection: A6's handover and A10's handover now run different contact setups. K5 says 'A6 devri bu IMU tabanlı algılayıcıyla yeniden koşulur'. But the existing tr35_handover (P5a deploy branch rl/eval_tasks.py ~L946) runs the main policy on model_variant='getup', with floor-active EXTRA boxes. K6.4 runs A10's main on the main variant, with pair-only EXTRA boxes, and copies the state to the getup variant when a fall is detected. So A6's ≥ 80 % handover result does not validate A10's path. The copy can also land the floor-only EXTRA boxes inside the floor.
objections.scenario: A forward fall from crouched walking on the main variant: the shin and thigh EXTRA boxes are pair-only, so the legs pass through the floor until the trunk or head is stopped. R6 already measured the shin box 1.0 mm below the sole plane at crouch row h = 0.1017 while upright. During the 6-step debounce after gz > −0.6, the penetration can only grow (stub thigh box half-height 29 mm). The state is then copied into the getup variant with cm-scale box–floor penetration. The contact solver resolves it with a large impulse, so getup starts from a non-physical kicked state. A10 records 'düşme + getup' or 'physics' outcomes that A6 never sees.
objections.suggestion: Re-run A6's handover in exactly A10's setup: main on the main variant, state copy at detection. Record the maximum EXTRA–floor penetration at copy time (via mj_geomDistance in eval only) and report copies above 2 mm as a separate category. Alternatively, trigger the variant switch, though not the controller's F state, at the first EXTRA–floor contact. If P5b makes the EXTRA boxes floor-active in main training (K6.4), use one variant throughout and drop the copy.
objections.section: K6.4 Temas modeli + K5 Düşme ve devir (A6 yeniden koşulur)
K3.5 İşaret; K5 Çıktılar ve Red işareti; K4 Uyanma
objections.objection: v2 kullanıcıya verilen bütün görsel geri bildirimi modülün kendi mavi LED'ine bağlıyor: uyanık pencere, red ve pencere bitişi. Ayrıca 'ek parça gerekmez' diyor. ESP32 bu LED'i süremez, çünkü DF2301Q'nun komut setinde LED komutu yok. LED'in ne gösterdiği de doğrulanmamış: research yalnız 'recognition-status LED' diyor, davranışı için kaynak yok. Sonuç olarak K5'in LED çıktısı ve altın izlerdeki LED olayları fiziksel bir hedefe gitmiyor.
objections.scenario: Robot OTURMUŞ (M) durumda. Kullanıcı 'ördek' der; LED modülün kendi mantığıyla yanar. Sonra 'evet' der. Tablo M'de evet/hayır için 'red' verir. M'de tık izni yok, tek işaret LED'in 3 kez yanıp sönmesi. ESP32 bu işareti üretemez; modül 'evet'i tanıdığı için LED kendi davranışını sürdürür (örneğin yanık kalır). Kullanıcı 'evet'i üç kez tekrarlar, robot bir şey yapmaz ve nedeni görünmez. Tur 1'deki S12(a) senaryosu aynen kalır. Firmware altın izlerdeki LED çıktısını da kopyalayamaz: altın iz doğrulaması LED satırlarında ya başarısız olur ya da bu satırlar sessizce atlanır.
objections.suggestion:
ESP32'nin sürdüğü bir gösterge tanımlayın ve K3.6 ICR'sini buna göre sayın. İki seçenek var:
(a) Kafaya ESP32 sürümlü tek bir LED koyun, örneğin modülün 5 V/GND dalını paylaşan bir WS2812 ya da 3 mm LED + direnç. Bu, dört geçişin her birinde 5. iletken olur; ICR çapları G-CAD'den önce buna göre verilmeli.
(b) DevKitC'nin kart üstü RGB LED'ini (GPIO38/48) kullanın: ışık borusu ve kabuk penceresi gerekir. Deck kafanın altında kaldığı için P2d, ayakta duran ve 1–2 m önde olan kullanıcıdan görüş hattını kontrol etmeli.
Modül LED'inin penceresi yalnız ikincil uyanma göstergesi olarak kalsın. G-SES-a, mavi LED'in uyanık pencere boyunca yanık kalıp kalmadığını kaydetsin. K5'teki LED çıktısı bu ESP32 göstergesine bağlansın.

objections.section: K8 Denemeler (30 dk uyanık pencere testi) ve Kapı
objections.objection: 30 dk'lık uyanık pencere yanlış komut testi, modülün gerçekten uyanık kaldığını ölçmüyor. 'Pencere 255' ayarı en çok 255 s sürer. Pencerenin yenilenmesi tek bir forum anekdotuna dayanıyor: UART'tan her 200 s'de setWakeTime(255) göndermek. Başka kullanıcılar ise yenilemenin ve host'tan enter-wake'in çalışmadığını, modülün 'birkaç dakika sonra çalışmayı bıraktığını' bildiriyor (voice-research §1.1 ve §2). 'Her 15 s'de yeniden uyandırma' ya çalışmayan host komutunu ya da konuşmayı gerektirir; ikisi de testin 'konuşmasız ve gözetimsiz' koşuluyla çelişir. Uyuyan ya da donmuş bir modül hiç komut kimliği üretmez; bu yüzden kapı boş yere geçer.
objections.scenario: Koşu başında setWakeTime(255) gönderilir; 200 s'lik yenileme etkisiz kalır ve modül 255 s sonra uyur. Kalan 25.75 dk boyunca servo gürültüsü yalnız uyanma kelimesini tetikleyebilir. Uyanma olmazsa komut sayısı 0'dır. Rapor: '30 dk uyanık pencerede 0 yanlış komut, Poisson %95 üst sınırı 1/10 dk' ve kapı geçer. Oysa gerçek maruziyet 4.25 dk'dır. 0 olay için %95 üst sınır 3/4.25 dk ≈ 0.7/dk, yani kapının yaklaşık 7 katı. Modül birkaç dakika sonra donarsa da aynı sonuç çıkar, çünkü UART begin() bağlantı olmasa bile true döner.
objections.suggestion:
Kapıyı doğrulanmış uyanık süreye göre yazın:
1. Uyanık durum sürekli loglansın. NOTIFY_WAKEUPENTER/EXIT çerçeveleri G-SES-a'da doğrulanırsa bunlar kullanılsın; doğrulanmazsa mavi LED'e bakan bir fototransistör ya da LDR, ESP32 ADC'sine bağlansın (birkaç TL).
2. Yeniden uyandırma yolu açıkça seçilsin. setWakeTime(255) + 200 s yenileme önce 10 dk'lık kısa bir koşuyla doğrulansın. Tutmazsa hoparlörden kayıtlı 'ördek' yaklaşık her 14 s'de çalınsın ve her çalmadan sonraki 2 s maruziyetten düşülsün.
3. Koşu, 30 doğrulanmış uyanık dakikaya ulaşana kadar uzasın.
4. Canlılık kontrolü: her 5 dk'da ve koşu sonunda kayıtlı bilinen bir kelime çalınsın ve tanındığı doğrulansın.
Doğrulanmış uyanık süre 30 dk'nın altında kalırsa sonuç 'geçti' değil 'ölçülemedi' olsun.

objections.section: K3.7 Hoparlör; K4 (17–21 ikinci şablon); K3 Yedek yol adım 1; K8 Öğrenme
objections.objection: Hoparlör hem setMuteMode(1) ile hem de SPK anahtarıyla susturuluyor: anahtar SPK2'ye alınıyor ve oraya hoparlör bağlı değil. Ayrıca sökülmesinin kazancı tartılıyor. DF2301Q'da öğrenme ve silme akışı sesli istemlerle ilerler: 'Learning now, be quiet...', 'Learning successful, please say it again', ardından sonraki kelimenin istenmesi (voice-research §1.1). Kafa kubbesinin içindeki anahtara erişilemez; hoparlör kapalı ya da sökülmüşse robot üstünde öğretim körleşir. Oysa v2'nin kendisi robot üstünde öğretim istiyor: K4'teki 'robot yürürken öğretilmiş dur' ikinci şablonu ve yedek yolun ilk adımı (şablonları yeniden öğretmek). Research de şablonların son akustik düzende ve servolar çalışırken öğretilmesini öneriyor.
objections.scenario: G-SES-a geçer, modül kafaya kapatılır, SPK anahtarı SPK2'dedir. Robot kurulunca 'dur' yürürken zayıf kalır. Kullanıcı K4'teki gibi ID 17'ye ikinci bir şablon öğretmek ister ve 'ördek, Learning command word' der. Modül istemlerini sessizce verir. Kullanıcı ne zaman konuşacağını bilemez ve üç tekrarı yanlış anlarda söyler. Şablon bozuk kaydolur ya da öğrenme zaman aşımına düşer; hangi kimliğin atandığı da duyulmaz. Anahtarı çevirmek için kafayı açmak gerekir; kafa açıkken akustik düzen artık 'son yerleşim' değildir. Hoparlör sökülmüşse bu yol hiç kalmaz. Bir de G-SES-a denemeleri hoparlör açıkken yapılırsa modül her tanımadan sonra yanıt sesi çalar; bu ses robotta olmayan bir gecikme ve gürültü kaynağıdır.
objections.suggestion:
Hoparlör kartta kalsın ve SPK anahtarı SPK1'de sabit olsun. Susturma yalnız yazılımla yapılsın: firmware her açılışta setMuteMode(1) gönderir; ayarın kalıcı olup olmadığı G-SES-a'da ölçülür.
Firmware'e bir 'öğrenme modu' tanımlayın, örneğin BOOT tuşuna uzun basınca açılsın. Bu mod setMuteMode(0) gönderir, gelen 200–208 ve yeni kimlikleri loglar, kimlik tablosunu günceller ve çıkışta modülü yeniden susturur. Kafa içinden istemin duyulup duyulmadığı G-SES-a'da denensin; duyulmuyorsa kabukta küçük bir ses yolu açılsın.
G-SES-a'da öğretim susturma kapalıyken, bütün denemeler setMuteMode(1) ile yapılsın. 'Hoparlör sökülür' seçeneği kaldırılsın.

objections.section: K3.6 Kablo demeti (ICR); K9 P2d
objections.objection: ICR neck demetini d 5 → 6 mm yapıyor ama donmuş geçiş noktasını (33.33, −34.4, 41.54) değiştirmiyor. Bu durumda demet boyun U-link'inin A kolunun dış yüzüne 0 mm açıklıkla dayanır. P2c'de A kolunun dış yüzü ya0 = fy − leg_a_t = −26.9 − 4.5 = −31.4 (worktree wf_760bffe2-b4a-3, cad/head.py:335). d 5'te demetin iç yüzü −31.9'da, açıklık 0.5 mm. d 6'da iç yüz −31.4'te, açıklık 0. P2c'nin kendi kuralı harness_clear = 0.4 mm. Ayrıca boyun 'in' tüpü trunk linkinde duruyor; P2b'nin neck_trunk/power/signal_wiring kanalları ona yüz yüze bağlanıyor ve sağ gövde kabuğundaki çentik tüpün y −36.9'a uzanmasına göre açılmış. Yani ICR bitmiş P2b geometrisini de değiştiriyor; K9 ise işi yalnız P2d'ye veriyor.
objections.scenario: Orkestratör ICR'yi yazıldığı gibi uygular. Sabit duran neck_pitch_harness_in tüpü (trunk) A kolunun yüzüne y = −31.4'te teğet olur. Boyun −110..40° dönerken A kolunun kutu kısmı tüpün z 18..41.5 bölümünün üstünden geçer. check.py demet temaslarını her zaman sayar; iki sonuç mümkün. Ya temas raporlanır ve P2d durur. Ya da sıfır hacimli teğet temas sayılmaz ve gerçek robotta 30 AWG teller her boyun hareketinde dönen PETG kola sürtünür. Aynı anda P2b'nin kanalları ve kabuk çentiği eski 5 mm'ye göre kalır: trunk tarafında demet bir geçişte daralır ya da kabuğun içine girer.
objections.suggestion:
ICR'yi iki seçenekten biriyle yazın:
(a) d 6 kalsın, geçiş noktası y −34.9'a kaysın. Açıklık 0.5 mm'ye döner; dış yüz −37.9'a gelir.
(b) Çapı gerçek iletken listesinden hesaplayın. 4 × 30 AWG silikon tel (dış çap ≈ 0.7–0.8 mm) 19.6 mm²'lik demete yaklaşık 2.5 mm² ekler; d ≈ 5.3 mm olur. Çap, A koluna en az 0.4 mm açıklık kalacak şekilde seçilsin.
Her iki durumda ICR kapsamına P2b dosyalarını da yazın: neck_trunk/power/signal_wiring kanalları ve sağ kabuk çentiği. P2d'nin bitti ölçütüne şunu ekleyin: 'check.py bütün modüllerde; tek eklem taraması ve demet temasları 0'. Diğer üç geçiş için de P2c'nin harness_route yollarında yeni yarıçapla kalan açıklık raporlansın.

objections.section: K3.3 Akustik (mikrofon contası)
objections.objection: Mikrofon contası 'TPU' olarak tanımlanmış; projede kullanılan TPU 95A (spec §3.1). 95A TPU akustik frekanslarda neredeyse rijittir. Conta, kartı servoları taşıyan kabuğa tam kapsülün yanında bağlar ve TPU beşiğin ya da grometlerin titreşim yalıtımını kısa devre eder.
objections.scenario:
Halka ölçüleri: iç çap 3 mm, dış çap 5 mm, yükseklik 1.5 mm. TPU 95A için E ≈ 12–26 MPa.
- Bir halkanın rijitliği k = E·A/h ≈ 100–220 N/mm; iki halka 200–440 N/mm.
- 14 g'lık kartı 100 Hz'in altında asmak için gereken toplam rijitlik ≈ 5.5 N/mm. Contalar bunun 40–80 katı.
- Sistem frekansı ≈ 600–890 Hz'e çıkar.
Kaput PLA'dır ve 4 × M2 ile kafa çerçevesine bağlıdır; roll MG90S ile SG90'ın dişli titreşimi konuşma bandının ortasında rezonansla kapsüle gelir. G-SES-a çıplak modülle yapıldığı için bunu görmez. G-SES-b'de görülür, ama o zaman yer ve kabuk donmuştur.
objections.suggestion: Contayı yumuşak bir malzemeyle tanımlayın: kapalı hücreli köpük (PORON tipi) ya da Shore ≤ 40A silikon halka, %20–30 sıkıştırmalı; gerekirse ağzına akustik file. Kabuktaki conta yuvası bu malzemeye göre çizilsin. Beşik ya da gromet için bir rijitlik hedefi konsun (örneğin f_n ≤ 100 Hz); contanın buna katkısı P2d raporuna yazılsın. TPU 95A yalnız beşik yayında kalsın.

objections.section: K3 Modül (muhafazakâr zarf); K3.1 Kütle dağılımı
objections.objection: Trunk'tan aktarılan 20 g, v2'nin kendi eklediği parçalar sayılınca neredeyse sıfır paya iniyor. Ayrıca zarf, konnektör fişini ve kablo çıkışını içermiyor.
objections.scenario:
Kütle hesabı:
- Kafa P2c'de 200.2 g; modül zarfı +14 g.
- Demet tüpleri p2-interface §6 kuralıyla sayılıyor (uzunluk × alan × 0.0017 g/mm³). P2c'nin kafa linklerindeki yollar: boyun çıkışı ≈ 42 mm, head_pitch ≈ 39 mm, head_yaw ≈ 68 mm, head_roll ≈ 49 mm. Yeni çaplarla tüp kütlesi ≈ 4.4 g'dan ≈ 6.8 g'a çıkar: +2.4 g.
- Beşik, iki conta, 47 µF + 100 nF + 1 kΩ, port ve LED penceresi çıkıntıları ve köpük ≈ 4–7 g.
- Toplam ≈ 220.6–223.6 g; bütçe 222 g. P2c'nin baskı satırı zaten 2.9 g aşıkta.
Bu durumda kafa kütle testi düşer ve bütçe için yeni bir ICR gerekir.
Zarf: research §1 delik konumlarını 'Gravity konnektör kenarından' ölçüyor ve mikrofonları aynı (sol) uçta gösteriyor. Buna göre PH2.0 fişi ve 4 telin bükümü, contalı iki mikrofon portunun arasına düşer. 52 × 34 × 14 mm'lik zarfta buna yer yok; P2d zarfı kabuğa yerleştirdikten sonra fiş kubbe duvarına çarpar.
objections.suggestion:
Aktarımı 30 g yapın: kafa 232 g, trunk 703.6 g. Trunk bütçesi P2b'nin ölçtüğü 654 g'ın hâlâ 49.6 g üstünde kalır. Beşik, contalar, pasifler ve köpük aşağıdan yukarı kütle listesine ayrı satır olarak girsin.
K8'in kumpas listesine konnektörün yeri ve takılı fişin yüksekliği eklensin; zarfa fiş ve büküm için bir yer ayırma kutusu konsun. Bunun yerine 4 tel fişsiz olarak doğrudan pedlere lehimlenebilir; o zaman beşikte bir gerilme tutucusu olsun.

objections.section: K3 BOM; K10
objections.objection:
BOM satırı yalnız modülü ve kargoyu sayıyor. v2 yeni zorunlu kalemler ekliyor ama bunları listelemiyor:
- 30 AWG silikon tel. Mevcut BOM'daki 30 AWG tel potlar için alınan Kynar wire-wrap'tır ve head_yaw'ın ±80° burulmasına uygun değildir.
- 47 µF + 100 nF + 1 kΩ, gerekirse bölücü dirençleri.
- Gromet, köpük ve conta malzemesi.
- G-SES-a senkron tıkı için piezo.
- 2H1 ve 2H2 kabul edilirse LED ve fototransistör.
Bu yüzden K10'da kullanıcıya verilen '≈ 1,3k TL' farkı eksik.
objections.scenario: Kullanıcı K10'da 'modül tavan dışında ayrı opsiyonel satır' seçeneğini seçer. P3, silikon tel rulosunu ve pasifleri yine zorunlu BOM'a ekler. H1'e göre yedekli tavanda kalan pay yaklaşık 100 TL. Tek bir tel rulosu (fiyatı henüz bakılmadı, büyük olasılıkla birkaç yüz TL) bu payı aşar. A2, kullanıcı kararından sonra yeniden düşer ve konu kullanıcıya ikinci kez gider.
objections.suggestion: Bu kalemleri K3 BOM'a şimdi mağaza, fiyat, stok ve tarihle ekleyin. K10'daki sayıyı ses katmanının tam farkı olarak verin: modül + kargo + yan kalemler. Opsiyonel satır seçeneği seçilirse yan kalemler de aynı opsiyonel bloğa girsin.

objections.section: K5 Uyanık pencere + K4 Uyanma
objections.objection: The controller, which firmware copies verbatim, itself drops commands outside '15 s after ördek, not renewed'. That rule is the sim's conservative model of the module. Placed in commands.py, it makes the firmware drop IDs that the module really sends whenever the real wake window is longer than the controller's. Possible causes: renewal on valid commands (one forum user reports it); setWakeTime not surviving power-up, so a 20 s default applies (K8 only measures both); a late or lost ID-1 frame. 'dur' is one of the IDs that gets dropped.
objections.scenario: G-SES-a finds that the window renews on each valid command. Firmware copies commands.py. The user says 'ördek' at t = 0 and 'gel' at t = 10 s (applied about 10.9 s), so the module now stays awake until 25 s. At t = 17 s the user says 'dur'. The module sends the ID, but the controller's window closed at 15 s, so the ID is ignored silently. The robot walks until gel's 10 s timeout at about 20.9 s, roughly 0.4 m further at 0.136 m/s.
objections.suggestion: Remove the window gate from commands.py: accept any whitelisted ID whenever the module sends it, and never drop 'dur'. Model the 15 s non-renewing window only in the A10 harness's module model. If the controller needs the window state, take it from NOTIFY_WAKEUPENTER/EXIT once G-SES-a confirms those frames. Add a K5 invariant that 'dur' is never dropped.

objections.section: K5 Tamamlanma (T1, T2, zaman aşımı)
objections.objection: T1 cannot finish inside its own window, and the retry does nothing. With tr35 constants the alpha ramp needs ceil(2.83/0.02) = 142 steps (2.84 s). T.hold_timer then needs 29 more steps for ready_hold_s = 0.6 s, so the earliest T1 is 3.42 s even with zero physical lag, later than the 3.4 s deadline. 'Re-issuing' kalk sets sit = 0 while sit and alpha are already 0, which is a no-op in main_command and posture_step. Every kalk therefore takes the timeout path, and the real deadline becomes 6.8 s, twice A5's window. T2 has neither a stillness nor a seat check: alpha = 1 at 2.84 s, and gz_obs < seat_gz (−0.245) holds for almost any pose that has not fallen.
objections.scenario: With a perfect policy, S1's first 'kalk' always hits the 3.4 s timeout, re-issues as a no-op, and is marked complete at 3.42 s in the second window. A policy that rocks on the seat and stands up only at 6 s is also scored 'complete', although A5 would count it as a failure. Implementations that count the hold differently (from reception, from application, or with the hold start ≤ 3.4 s) disagree on the first attempt, so golden traces change with the convention.
objections.suggestion: T1: the condition first holds within 3.4 s of application (A5 window) and then holds continuously for ready_hold_s, with a hard limit of STAND_RAMP_S + ready_hold_s + 0.5 s ≈ 3.9 s. Replace the retry with a real action (for kalk: sit = 1 back to the seat, wait for T2, then one more kalk) or drop it. T2: add |gyro_obs| < threshold for ready_hold_s and |pitch − SEAT_PITCH_DEG| < X.

objections.section: K5 Tamamlanma (ikinci zaman aşımı → DÜŞMÜŞ) + Düşme ve devir
objections.objection: The recovery path that v2 introduces starts getup from seated and half-seated poses. Getup never trained on them, and neither A6 nor A10 measures them. The path is: a T1/T2 failure, or a tilt of more than 35° from pitch_ref(alpha) in O/M/K, leads to DÜŞMÜŞ and getup. The getup resets are fallen (HOME ±0.3 rad, dropped), midfall (standing, tilted 15–35°) and stand. The stub seat (hip_pitch 85° against the family HOME's −17.5°, pitch −50°, trunk box on the floor) is far outside all three.
objections.scenario: This is R4's case: kalk from the seat, the robot rocks back and stays at a pitch of about −50°. When alpha falls to about 0.55, pitch_ref rises above −15° (crouch rows 0.092 m), so the tilt from pitch_ref exceeds 35°. After 6 debounce steps, F starts getup about 1.4 s into K, from the seat pose. Getup acts on an out-of-distribution state for 12 s, twice, and then goes to B. At A5's ≥ 95 % stand rate this affects up to 5 % of S1 episodes and about 10–15 % of S2 episodes (2–3 transitions each), and A10 scores them as 'fall + getup'.
objections.suggestion: Send transition failures in O/M/K to 'back to the seat' (sit = 1, then T2), then to B with the red signal, not to getup. Alternatively, add seated and half-seated starts to the getup reset mix in P5b, and a 'failed stand-up → getup' case to A6/A10 before P7.

objections.section: K6.1 Jest kanalı (alpha kapısı) + K5 tablo (dur: jest kesilir; otur in A)
objections.objection: 'Alpha kapısı rastgele ofsetle aynıdır' works for the random offset only because that gate is applied before the τ = 0.5 s filter. The gesture skips the filter, so the same gate becomes a hard step. v2 also cuts a gesture on dur ('jest kesilir'), and lets otur or a fall happen during a gesture, without any fade; this is the cut-off case R1 raised. Applied to the mouth, the same gate zeroes vak whenever alpha ≥ 0.01. That contradicts K5 (vak allowed in M, ≤ 15°) and K6.1 ('gaga oturuş segmentlerinde de örneklenir'): the seated beak exposure accepted in R9/S14 is never trained.
objections.scenario: In A the robot shakes its head ('hayır', head_yaw at +0.348 rad on its first peak), and 'otur' arrives (A→O). At the second ramp step alpha = 0.0141 ≥ ALPHA_STAND_MAX, the gate closes, and head_yaw ctrl drops 0.348 rad in 20 ms. That is 17.4 rad/s: 2.7 × slew_max (6.55 rad/s) and above MG90S ω0 (13.1). Training produces the same step at every stand/walk → sit segment boundary that falls inside a gesture. The 'assert like slew_max' then either trips during training or, if it checks only the template, passes while the env emits steps. In M, 'vak' outputs 0 because alpha = 1.
objections.suggestion: Gate only the gesture start (a gesture may start when alpha < ALPHA_STAND_MAX). Either let a running gesture finish (at most 1.67 s; otur in A and a sit segment wait for it), or end it with a fixed 0.2 s raised-cosine fade-out, also on dur and on a fall. No alpha gate on the mouth; cap it at 15° when alpha > ALPHA_STAND_MAX. Assert the slew limit on the summed head ctrl (default + offset + gesture), not on the template.

objections.section: K5 Gyro bias
objections.objection: The stillness test (|gyro| < 0.02 rad/s for at least 1 s) sits at the sensor model's own noise level, so the accepted bias update essentially never runs. sensors.IMU gyro_sigma is 0.02 rad/s per axis, uniform ±0.0346, drawn fresh every tick, and the 50 Hz gyro_obs is the last tick. For a perfectly still robot, a single z sample passes with p = 0.577, 50 samples in a row with 1.2e-12, and the 3-axis norm with 1.5e-50. Read instead as a 1 s mean, the test fails whenever |b_z| > 0.02. That is half of the K7 sensitivity run U(±0.04), exactly the episodes the update is meant for.
objections.scenario: In the A10 sensitivity run b_z = 0.035 rad/s. The robot stands still before 'sağa dön', but |gyro_obs| never drops below 0.02, so no bias is taken. The 90° integral ends 0.035 × 4.45 s = 0.156 rad (8.9°) early, the error adds up over 2 turns, and the run reports the uncorrected error as if the correction were working. Under the per-sample reading the update does not fire even with b = 0.
objections.suggestion: Make the stillness test independent of the bias: over a 1 s window, the per-axis std of gyro_obs is below 2·gyro_sigma, all leg |qd_obs| are below a threshold, and the velocity command is zero. Take the window mean as the bias and clip it to |b| ≤ 0.06 rad/s. Add a unit test on the real sensor model: a still robot with b = 0.04 is updated within 2 s.

objections.section: K5 tablo (O ve M sütunları, Kuyruk, Y/D 'dur, 1.0 s, →O')
objections.objection: Two stateful gaps remain in the table. (a) Queue lifetime: a command queued in O is never consumed. O's completion cell is only '→M', M's is '—', and only dur clears the queue. So the command survives in M; M's kalk cell ('→K') does not replace it; and K's completion cell ('→A, bekleyen uygulanır') finally fires it. The table also does not say whether a fall, a window close or B clears the queue. (b) The 'dur, 1.0 s, →O' cells of Y and D create a 1 s sub-state with no column (S2's own example). A word in that second can be read under Y (gel cancels otur, evet plays, dur → A) or under O (queued, red). In O and K, 'geçiş biter' can mean either stop or finish.
objections.scenario: The user says 'otur', then 1 s later 'gel', which is queued in O. The robot sits, and gel stays pending in M. A minute later the user says 'ördek, kalk': M → K → A applies the stale gel, and the robot walks 1.36 m (10 s × 0.136 m/s) without being asked. Second case: in Y the user says 'otur' and, inside the 1 s settle, 'evet'. One implementation nods and then sits; another rejects with the red signal. Both match the table.
objections.suggestion: Add an explicit column Ö (OTURMA ÖNCESİ, 1.0 s) with its own cells. O→M: if something is pending, kalk/gel/dön → K with bekleyen kept; otherwise '—'. Clear the queue on a fall, on entering B and on window expiry. Write 'geçiş tamamlanır (kesilmez)' in O and K. Add a random-sequence invariant: a pending command is applied within one completed transition or is cleared.

objections.section: K7 S2 zaman çizelgesi
objections.objection: Each S2 word comes U(1, 6) s after the previous command completes, so no word is ever spoken while a command is running. Every S2 word lands in A or M (or F/B after a fall), and gel always runs to its 10 s timeout. The Y, D, O and K columns never receive a word in closed-loop physics. Of their 32 command cells, the only one A10 ever exercises is S1's single 'dur' in Y. Never tested physically: Y→D and D→Y re-targeting, otur from walking (the 1.0 s settle), eğil while walking, gestures while walking or turning, every 'kuyruk' cell, and dur during a transition. These are the cells where controller timing meets the policy. 'Completion' is also undefined for red, '—' and queued words, and S2 has no start state.
objections.scenario: Suppose the controller has a bug in 'otur in Y' (it skips the 1.0 s settle and sits while still moving), or the policy falls whenever 'sağa dön' cuts a gel. Both pass S2 with no falls, because S2 only ever issues otur and sağa from A. The round-1 S2 estimate that 37 % of words land inside a ramp no longer holds, because timing now starts at completion.
objections.suggestion: Time each S2 word from the previous word's application (U(1, 6) s), not from its completion. Define the completion of red, '—' and queued words as their application. Set the S2 start state (for example 50/50 home/seated, as in A5). Report per-cell coverage and require every table cell to be hit at least 20 times over the 256 episodes.

objections.section: K3.5 İşaret + K5 Red işareti / Çıktılar (LED durumu)
objections.objection: v2 dropped H8's ESP32-driven LED in favour of the module's own blue status LED ('ek parça gerekmez'). No known DF2301Q host API drives that LED; voice-research lists getCMDID, playByCMDID, setWakeTime, setVolume, setMuteMode, SET_ENTERWAKEUP (reported not to work) and resetModule. So 'LED 3 kez yanıp söner' and the controller's 'LED durumu' output have no implementation, and G-SES-a does not check for one. In O, M, K, F and B the red signal is LED-only, so those states give no feedback at all.
objections.scenario: The robot is seated (M) and the user says 'evet'. K5 says red. The firmware cannot blink the module LED, which stays lit while the module is awake, and no tick is allowed in M. The user cannot tell a rejection from a misrecognition, the S12(a) silent-failure case that was accepted for fixing. The golden traces contain LED blink outputs that the firmware has no pin to drive.
objections.suggestion: Add an ESP32 GPIO LED (about 1 g) behind the same shell window, as H8 proposed, and drive the red blink and the window state from it through 'LED durumu'. Alternatively, add a G-SES-a check that the host can blink the module LED, and allow the 12° tick in M (it is within the ≤ 15° cap).

objections.section: K5 Çıktılar ('tut') + tablo F/B, devir
objections.objection: The getup states lack entry and exit actions. (a) BEKLE's output 'tut' is undefined: last getup ctrl, HOME, tuck, or PWM off. (b) On F→A (devir) the controller does not reset its own h_cmd, sit or pending command. (c) Words that arrive during handoff_zero_cmd_s (1.0 s) are accepted at once by the A column, overriding the zero command that A6's handover relies on (S3 item 4).
objections.scenario: After two failed getups on the back, the robot enters B. One firmware build holds the last getup target with the knees loaded for minutes, while the sim holds HOME. Second case: before the fall the user had said eğil twice (h_cmd = H_MIN_WALK). After devir, main gets h_ref = H_HOME but h_cmd = H_MIN_WALK and starts crouching inside the zero-command window, a condition A6 never tests. A 'gel' repeated in that window starts walking 0.5 s after the handover.
objections.suggestion: Define B, for example: a 0.5 s ramp to HOME, then leg PWM off with the head at HOME (any choice, but written down). F→A entry action: h_cmd = H_HOME, sit = 0, queue cleared. Queue words that arrive during handoff_zero_cmd_s and apply them after it.

objections.section: K5 Altın izler
objections.objection: The golden traces are 'olay dizisi → çıktı dizisi', but half of the transitions depend on per-step sensor inputs: T1/T2, the fall debounce, the gyro integral, the bias window and the timers. A trace of events alone cannot replay them on firmware. The number type and the comparison rule are not given either.
objections.scenario: The firmware port integrates gyro_z in float32, or counts the 0.6 s hold from a different step, while commands.py uses float64. With event-only traces, both differences go unnoticed until the robot runs: the turn ends a step later, and T1 flips at the 3.4 s knife edge (2S2).
objections.suggestion: Make each golden-trace row one control step: t, ID events, gravity_obs, gyro_obs, alpha, h_ref → state, main command, policy select, gesture targets, LED. Generate traces from S1/S2 rollouts plus the synthetic table tests. Run commands.py in np.float32 throughout. Compare discrete outputs exactly and continuous outputs within a stated tolerance.

objections.section: K7 S1 evet/hayır ölçütü
objections.objection: A two-cycle raised-cosine gesture never reaches the table amplitude. Its trajectory peaks at 0.870·A (nod 0.174 of 0.2 rad, shake 0.348 of 0.4 rad), its full peak-to-peak is 1.74·A, and the 2nd-cycle peak-to-peak is only 1.09·A. 'genlik ≥ komutun %80'i' does not say which reference is meant.
objections.scenario: Read against the table amplitude, a perfect servo has 0.8° of margin (nod peak 9.97° against 9.17°). The MG90S deadband DR (up to 0.9° full width), the PWM step (0.44°) and the P-band lag at 1.5 Hz can use that up, so S1 fails because of the actuator, not the policy. Under round-1 S5's reading (2nd-cycle peak-to-peak against 2A), every episode reaches only 55 % and fails.
objections.suggestion: Define the measure as (max − min of pot q over the gesture) ≥ 0.8 × (max − min of the commanded gesture trajectory) = 0.8 × 1.74·A, with pot bias removed.

objections.section: K7 Koşullar (uyanma modeli) + S1 zaman çizelgesi
objections.objection: 'Gerektiğinde ördek yeniden söylenir' gives no rule. In S1, 'dur' is spoken about 13.5–16 s after the first ördek is recognized (kalk latency + 3.42 s T1 + 1 s + gel latency + 8 s), right at the edge of the 15 s non-renewing window. A word recognized after the window closes is lost. A re-wake adds 0.3–1.5 s plus reaction time, which pushes dur past gel's 10 s timeout at about 17 s.
objections.scenario: One harness has dur spoken at 14.7 s; recognition ends at 15.6 s with the window closed, so dur is lost. Gel ends by its timeout, and the dur stopping distance is recorded as 0 m or missing in about half of the episodes. A second harness re-wakes first and gets valid samples. The same policy gets different A10 results.
objections.suggestion: Specify the harness: before any word, if the remaining window is shorter than 1.5 s plus the word length, say ördek first (latency U(0.3, 1.5) s plus 0.5 s reaction). In S1, re-wake right before 'dur' and count its 8 s to the moment dur is spoken. Check that the gel timeout exceeds 8 s plus the maximum dur latency.

objections.section: K9 P2d + K3.6 demet ICR'si
objections.objection: The ICR changes the frozen params.harness diameters that the finished P2b and P2c geometry and tests depend on, yet K9 gives P2d only the head dome. With neck d 5 → 6 mm, the neck entry tube reaches y −37.4 instead of −36.9. P2b notched the right torso shell around it (shell_holes), and test_trunk_fc checks that the neck channel touches that tube face to face. head_yaw and head_roll go from 3.5 to 4.5 mm, about +0.5 mm of radius, in P2c's re-routed head harness, whose clearance H9 put at 0.4 mm.
objections.scenario: P2d applies the ICR and builds. test_trunk_fc fails on the neck channel contact, the P2b shell notch interferes with the 6 mm tube, and the head_yaw route can go below zero clearance at the MG90S corner (head_pitch 38–54). P2d does not own cad/trunk.py or cad/head.py, so it stops and G-CAD slips.
objections.suggestion: In K9, give P2d explicit edit rights to the trunk shell notch and the P2c harness_route, with a full check.py, tests/cad and golden run as exit criteria. Alternatively, issue the ICR first as a short P2b/P2c touch-up step before P2d.

not_applied: R12 (Kabul: 'dur duruş mesafesi ölçütü'). K7 measures the dur stopping distance 'uygulamadan duruşa' (from application). R12 asked for 'from the end of the spoken word to standstill', so the latency is part of what is measured. Every other A10 metric (gel ratio, turn, completion windows, eğil, gestures) is also timed from application. The eval-only latency U(0.3, 1.5) s, and the latency that G-SES-a measures, therefore still affect no A10 criterion. R12's point that 'the DR tests nothing' still holds, and the ~0.20 m travelled during 1.5 s of latency at 0.136 m/s is still not measured. Fix: measure from the end of the word, p90 ≤ 0.3 m; that is feasible, since 1.38 s at p90 × 0.136 ≈ 0.19 m plus braking. Report the latency-free distance alongside.

S14 (Kabul: 'jaw çifti P5b listesinde'). The K9 P5b item only says 'P5k on the final MJCF; move A10 to the final model'. It does not add P2c's jaw–neck contact pair (the open ICR) to the P5b self-collision pair list. Meanwhile K5 still allows vak in OTURMUŞ (≤ 15°) at HEAD_SIT head_pitch 55.5°. Without the pair the sim cannot show the lower beak rubbing the neck link; A8 only reports interference volume afterwards.

R9 (Kabul: 'gaga şablonu oturuş segmentlerinde de'). K6.1 says this, but the same bullet list says 'Alpha kapısı rastgele ofsetle aynıdır' (alpha < ALPHA_STAND_MAX = 0.01). If that gate also covers the mouth channel, the beak is zeroed in every sit segment (alpha = 1), and the seated vak (≤ 15°) that K5 allows in M is never trained. See 2R4.

S12 + H8 (R9'daki uyanma işareti de buna bağlı). Karar şuydu: red işareti LED + çift tık, pencere bitişi LED, LED birincil işaret (H8'in önerisi ESP32'nin sürdüğü bir LED idi). v2 K3.5 bunu modülün kendi mavi durum LED'iyle yapıyor ve 'ek parça gerekmez' diyor. DF2301Q'nun UART/I2C komut setinde LED komutu yok; yalnız volume, mute, wake time, enter-wake ve playByCMDID var (voice-research §1.2). LED'i modülün kendi firmware'i sürer. Bu yüzden K5'teki '3 kez yanıp sönme' red işareti ve 'LED durumu' çıktısı donanımda üretilemez. Tık izni olmayan O, M, K, F ve B durumlarında red yine sessiz kalır; S12(a) açık. Ayrıntı ve öneri 2H1'de.

H5 (kısmen) / S9. Karar, G-SES-a gürültüsünü Adım 0'ın gerçek MG90S + SG90 + DS'siyle üretmekti. tools/bench/bench/bench_main.cpp yalnız tek bir PCA kanalı sürüyor (C.ch). K9'daki P6 eki yalnız şunları ekliyor: UART okuma, kimlik zaman damgası, senkron tık ve pin haritası. Çok kanallı jest/salınım programı planda yok; analog MG90S/SG90 için tek PCA'nın 50 Hz'e alınması da yok. Bu yüzden K8'in gürültülü düzeneği ve 'servolar çalışırken' 30 dk testi yazıldığı haliyle koşturulamaz.

S14. Karar metni 'jaw çifti P5b listesinde' diyor. v2'de bunun karşılığı hiçbir yerde yok (K6, K9'daki P5b satırı): ne jaw–neck / jaw–trunk temas çifti (P2c ICR'si) ne de 'head_pitch > 50° iken mouth ≤ 25°' kilidi.

H6. Karar, pil süresi koşusunu ve koşu sonu canlılık kontrolünü G-SES-b'ye bıraktı. v2 K2, G-SES-b'yi yalnız 'robot üstünde son yerleşimle tanıma testi' olarak tanımlıyor. Ertelenen koşu ekte hiçbir yere yazılmamış, bu yüzden kaybolur.

R1: v2 still does not say how a running gesture stops without a position step. The table only says dur 'jest kesilir', and otur and a fall act through the alpha gate. This is the gap R1 raised. The S1 amplitude measure also lost R1's 'pot q peak-to-peak vs template peak-to-peak': K7 says only 'genlik ≥ komutun %80'i' (see 2S4, 2S11).

R4: A10 scores each step with the controller's own IMU completion (K7: 'K5'in fiziksel ölçütleriyle'). R4 proposed A5's true-state success rules (standup_z, stand_gz, windows). The T2 condition gz_obs < seat_gz (−0.245 on the stub) is met by almost any pose that has not fallen, so the seat step stays close to command-side completion (alpha = 1).

R5: the note to P5b is missing. Main's training termination still uses the fixed gz > −0.6 rule. A seated stub has gz −0.643, and the seated bank's ±5° tilt crosses −0.6. v2 changes only the runtime detector.

R12: K7 measures the dur stopping distance from application. R12 proposed measuring from the end of the spoken word. The latency part that motivated R12 (up to 1.5 s × 0.136 m/s = 0.20 m) is therefore excluded, while the 0.3 m threshold stayed.

R13/H14: the zero-velocity bias update uses |gyro| < 0.02 rad/s, which equals sensors.IMU gyro_sigma (0.02 per axis, uniform ±0.035). It essentially never fires in sim, so the accepted fix does not work (see 2S5).
S2: the exact S2 case, a word arriving during the 'dur + 1.0 s' settle before sitting, still has no column. The O→M completion cell does not say what happens to a command queued in O (see 2S6).

S3: item 4 (commands that arrive during handoff_zero_cmd_s after the handover) is not addressed: F→A accepts them at once. BEKLE's output 'tut' is left undefined, although S3 asked for a defined hold (HOME hold or torque off) (see 2S9).
S11(e): K9 does not make the P6 bench-script addendum a prerequisite of Adım 0 / G-SES-a, although K8 needs it.
S14(c): the decision table says 'jaw çifti P5b listesinde', but v2 has no jaw–neck or jaw–trunk contact-pair item for P5b.
H6(c): v2 has no firmware liveness check for a silent module ('stops working after a few minutes'; begin() returns true with no module attached).

H8: H8 asked for an ESP32-driven LED visible through the shell. v2 (K3.5) uses the module's own status LED, which no known API lets the host blink. The K5 red blink and the 'LED durumu' output therefore cannot be implemented (see 2S8).
